description: Source code implementing configuration and parameter handling for Azure OpenAI O-series models within the Responses API, including support checks, parameter filtering, and model type identification.

classes.name: AzureOpenAIOSeriesResponsesAPIConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for handling Azure OpenAI O-series models, managing supported parameters, parameter mapping, and model type identification.

methods.name: get_supported_openai_params
methods.description: Returns a list of supported parameters for a given O-series model, excluding unsupported ones like 'temperature'.

methods.name: map_openai_params
methods.description: Maps and filters OpenAI parameters for O-series models, dropping 'temperature' if specified.

methods.name: is_o_series_model
methods.description: Determines if a given model name corresponds to an O-series model based on its name or reasoning support.
